same-bucket row differences --[subtraction]--> static homogeneous kernel
two proportional signatures --> quotient rank one

obligations.name: same-bucket quotient dimension
obligations.evidence: Every row in a fixed (a,b) bucket has the same quotient signature; all differences are static.
obligations.scope: Prime-order cyclic subgroup after a maximal homogeneous quotient.

obligations.name: complete signature-pair control
obligations.evidence: 19200 complete buckets and 451200 signature pairs were checked; determinant and matrix rank always agree.
obligations.scope: All projective four-log profiles over Z/7Z.

obligations.name: P-256 same-signature replay
obligations.evidence: The 327-row enlarged target bucket and proportional-signature stage retain rank 164; the independent generator signature reaches rank 165 across 984 group replays.
obligations.scope: Synthetic deterministic labels, not a relation construction on FB1hc72514a2a8d3.

obligations.name: two-signature P-256 event
obligations.evidence: No non-scalar-labelled event emits both target coupling and an independent generator signature.

obligations.name: complete below-rho recovery
obligations.evidence: The two-signature free oracle is above rho and no complete relation/decomposition/recovery pipeline exists.

controls: The toy census retained and replayed 6585600 bucket rows and 902400 pair representatives with zero discrepancies.
Five P-256 stages were ranked over two fields in both row orders and replayed through 984 exact group equations.
Rounds 298, 304, and corrected 305 were imported only after exact byte-hash, schema, curve, factor-base, width, boundary, and gate checks.
cost_accounting: Measured: toy coefficient tests, retained bucket rows, pair determinants, rank operations, P-256 scalar multiplications, group additions, equation replays, process telemetry, and artifact sizes.
Imported without extrapolation: Round-304 unquotiented and one-anchor oracle boundaries.
Unset: a non-labelled two-signature event, relation yield, structured solver, sparse linear algebra, target recovery, and complete attack cost.
exploration_boundary: Exact for rows sharing a fixed generator/target walk signature after a maximal static quotient; not a bound on an event that emits multiple nonproportional signatures.
weakest_open_obligation: Construct and replay one P-256 event that emits two nonproportional signatures, including target coupling and a generator anchor, then price complete recovery below rho.
narrowest_supported_finding: Any number of decompositions in one fixed P-256 target/walk bucket contributes at most one post-static dimension. Full rank requires two nonproportional bucket signatures; no qualifying event is constructed.
